items.html: And indeed, there is in this a difficulty, namely: it was already explained by us that the lowest degree in all of Atzilut is superior to everything below it, until the end of Assiyah; and likewise, in this manner, in all the degrees — for also the lowest degree of Beriah is greater than everything below it, which are Yetzirah and Assiyah. And if so, how did we say above that only the four first [Sefirot] of the world of Yetzirah were above, in the place where the Nukva of Atzilut now stands, while the rest of the six lower Sefirot of Yetzirah remained below, in the place that is now Beriah? And behold, in the lowest degree of the Nukva of Atzilut, all the worlds beneath it could have stood.
